summary: Opaque native binary with credential-store and host-enumeration capabilities under a generic name
details: Package ships a single ~10 MB Linux x86_64 Rust N-API binary (tools.linux-x64-gnu.node) as its `main` with a one-line README, no source, and no accompanying JS wrapper in the tarball. Extracted strings inside the binary show a full HTTP+TLS client (ureq_proto, rustls), zstd/zip compression, an SQLite client (SQLITE_AUTH_USER) — the shape used to read browser Login Data / Cookies stores — and host/user enumeration primitives (getifaddrs, gethostname, /dev/disk/by-id/, /etc/lsb-release, environ, network_adapters, "Found login for"). The package name resembles a legitimate native-tools sidecar but the binary content matches a browser-credential-database + host-fingerprint + HTTPS-exfiltration stack rather than any documented tooling purpose. No lifecycle scripts are declared, so harm requires the caller to require() the binary through a companion wrapper package of the same base name; that wrapper is not shipped here, so end-to-end install-time execution is not observable in this tarball alone.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
